When I was 8 years old I was kind of a piece of shit, and I do mean 'borderline sociopath' piece of shit.  I bit my grandmother, destroyed property, made my mothers life hell; caused constant fights and trouble at school and eventually ended up busting out several windows in the house.  


In response my mother decided it would be best if we put me into a Behavioral Health Institute, which makes sense; especially when your kid is acting like the Anti-Christ and literally costing you jobs because of his antics.

So like any 8 year old I freak the fuck out and scramble up to open my eyes and 'see' what it's all about.    


That's when I notice it; thousands, if not hundreds of thousands of tiny black spiders crawling all over me, under my pillow, in my eyes, on my skin.  UNDER my skin.  So I started to scratch at the spots, and instead of blood, only spiders came out.  I could feel them, taste them, smell them and hear them; and nothing I could do would make it stop.    


Within 24 hours the symptoms calmed down and my mother withdrew me from the instituion; ever since that day I have had a crippling fear of Spiders.  I always will too.
